messages:
OpsBot: ALERT: S2 - increased 5xx and timeouts on embeddings-service (us-west-2). Error rate at ~18% over last 5m. Paging oncall. link: https://ops.redwood.local/incidents/1718456789 :rotating_light:
Alex: acked, oncall taking it. starting triage. :eyes:
Sara: I'm oncall. looking at prod logs now. any threads showing degraded latency for customers?
Jordan: CS here — getting inbound tickets about slow embeddings from a small group of customers in USW. No broad outages reported by customers yet.
Priya: copying quick customer-facing text we can drop into Zendesk/Intercom while we investigate:
Priya: ```Zendesk/Intercom draft:
Hi there — we're investigating reports of degraded performance for embeddings in the US West region. Our engineers are looking into it and we'll update you within 30 minutes. If you have urgent impact (e.g., production blocking), reply here and we'll prioritize.
Thanks for your patience,
Redwood Support
```
Mike: quick troubleshooting checklist for agents to triage incoming tickets:
Mike: - Confirm customer region (us-west-2) and model variant.
- Ask for recent request IDs (if available) or sample timestamps.
- Check if they're hitting rate limits or using very long sequences.
- Suggest temporary workaround: switch to a compatible region (us-east-1) or use a lower-throughput batching until we resolve.
- Escalate to oncall with request IDs and customer impact severity.
Alex: adding internal status page copy (short) we can post to status.redwood.ai and to internal #incidents channel. will also include rollback/fallback actions.
Alex: ```Status page (short):
We are investigating elevated error rates and timeouts for the Embeddings API in US West (us-west-2). Customers may experience increased latency or failed requests. Our engineers are actively investigating. Updates every 30 minutes. Incident ID: 1718456789
```
Sara: digging into autoscaling/worker pool in us-west-2 — seeing a pattern of worker OOMs on quantized models after a recent kernel update. Reverting gpu-kernel-v2 on the pool now (rolling restart). ETA ~6 min for first batch.
Jordan: for customer comms, here's a slightly more empathetic variant for high-impact customers:
Jordan: ```High-impact customer note:
Hi <CustomerName>,
We’ve identified a problem causing higher error rates for embedding requests from US West. We’ve started a rollback that should restore service for most customers within ~10 minutes. We’ll monitor your traffic and follow up once stabilized. If this is blocking you right now, let us know and we’ll open a bridge.
— Jordan, Redwood Support
```
Priya: tagging necessary macros to paste into Zendesk: `embeddings_usw_degradation_v1` and `temp_region_workaround_v1`.
Mike: internal triage checklist (for oncall):
- Confirm rollback started and observe error-rate curve.
- Identify whether any customer requests are still failing post-rollback.
- Collect 3 sample request IDs per impacted customer to submit to infra team.
- If rollback doesn't reduce errors in 15m, prepare canary-redeploy to previous runtime.
Alex: @Sara can you confirm when first rollback batch completes and paste the error-rate graph snapshot? I'll push the status page update once you confirm drop in errors.
Sara: rollback batch 1 complete. error rate down to ~6% (from 18%). attaching brief logs: ```worker-123 OOM at 1718456750, restart ok```
OpsBot: NOTE: automated post to #incidents queued once `statuspage_update` tag is set.
Jordan: customer-facing update to send now (30m update):
Jordan: ```Customer update (30m):
Hi — quick update: we've deployed a rollback in US West that has reduced failed requests. Some customers may still see intermittent errors; engineering is continuing remediation. Next update in 30 minutes.
Thanks for bearing with us.
```
Priya: Intercom quick reply (short) for customers who ask if there is ETA: `We're seeing improvements after a rollback; full recovery expected within 10-20 minutes; we'll message you when it's fully resolved.`
Mike: handoff notes for next shift/oncall (copy into the handoff thread):
Mike: - Incident ID: 1718456789
- Timeline: spike detected -> paged oncall -> kernel rollback started at t+4m -> errors dropped to ~6% after first batch
- Actions taken: rolling revert of gpu-kernel-v2 on us-west pool, monitoring for regressions
- Open tasks: verify no remaining OOMs, confirm per-customer success rates, prepare for canary redeploy if errors climb
Alex: quick internal comm template for execs (one-liner + status):
Alex: `Exec note: Embeddings degraded in USW due to worker OOMs after kernel update. Rollback in progress; partial recovery observed. No evidence of data loss. CS engaged with impacted customers.`
Sara: leaving this thread — passing to @Alex for continuous updates while I confirm full stabilization. Handoff ETA 10m. :white_check_mark:
Alex: thanks. I'll keep the thread updated and post final "resolved" status once metrics look green for 30m. I'll also paste final Zendesk macro to close tickets.
Priya: proposed ticket-closure macro (post-resolve):
Priya: ```Closure macro:
Hi — the issue impacting embeddings in US West has been resolved. We reverted the recent kernel update which restored normal service. Please reply if you see any further issues and we'll reopen immediately.
Thanks for your patience,
Redwood Support
```
Jordan: :thumbsup: nice. I'll queue outbound replies for the customers who reported production impact.
OpsBot: Incident actions logged. Reminder: fill out post-incident notes and impact matrix in the incident tracker once resolved.
